scenario.summary: Signed in: selects two products on the Quick Order Pad with their quantities, adds them to the cart, checks the cart icon count equals the total quantity, sets the first cart line to inputQuantity and checks the count again, then empties the cart.
steps: Open the webstore and sign in
Quick Order, Add Multiple Items, Paste Multiple
Select multipleProductsCountToBeAdded products from the auto-suggestion (rows product0..product1 of multipleValidProductsAndTheirQuantity) and type their ProductQuantity
Add to Cart; verify Remove All link
Verify cart icon count = sum of quantities = sum of cart line quantities
Set the first cart line quantity to inputQuantity; verify cart icon count = sum of line quantities
stateChanges: Account cart: two products added, first line set to 51, then all removed
assertions: Cart icon count = total typed quantity
Cart icon count = sum of cart line quantities (before and after the quantity change)
evidence: Independent method (priority 50, no dependsOn): it opens the webstore itself and clears the quick list / cart at the end, so it declares its own needs.

Read by the page object, not scanned: QuickOrderPadPage.addMultipleProductsToCartUsingSkus reads table multipleValidProductsAndTheirQuantity (TestDataConstants.TEST_DATA_QUICK_ORDER_MULTIPLE_PRODUCTS_DATA, sheet quickOrderPage) rows product0..product<N-1>, columns ProductSku and ProductQuantity. It selects ProductSku of each row in pad row i via the auto-suggestion and types ProductQuantity in quantity box i, returning the sum (the expected cart count). No source entries: the cells are not in any scan and the workbook is not read. Table position: quickOrderPasteMultipleSkusPageData data rows end at 31, so the table starts after row 31; its row count is unknown (at least 2: multipleProductsCountToBeAdded = 2 reads product0 and product1). ASSUMPTION (needs review): two rows; the migrated test loops over the declared needs.

Quantities: ProductQuantity values are not scanned (config). ShoppingCartPage.setQuantity types inputQuantity 51 (quickOrderPage!C28, config) into txtCartItemQuantity, the FIRST cart line's quantity box, so product0 = PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 51, minMaxQuantity 51, maxPersonalizableAttributes 0}; product1 = {quantityUsed 1, maxPersonalizableAttributes 0}. ASSUMPTION: the migrated test types quantity 1 per row (the expected count is computed from the typed quantities, so no assertion depends on the sheet value) and cart line 1 is product0 (first added).
Distinct records: product0 and product1 are separate PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK needs; the resolver gives them different SKUs (identity sku), which the line-item / cart-count checks need.
No preferred: the sheet SKUs are not in any scan.

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): this method signs in itself with loginPage.successfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/quickOrderRetailUserTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B190/C190). An account lease (useExisting) is held by the method that declares it and released when that method ends, so every signing-in method declares its own need user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: its username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting), as the Selenium pilot entries T01-T04. Username/password are credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its own sheet. The scanner recorded the credential values only on LoginWithAUserAccount, MaximumAndMinimumQuantityValidations and AddMultipleProductsToCart; on the other methods the same two cells (same location, kind and masking) are declared from the test source (every method calls successfullLogin with them).

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart entries and the Playwright quick-order entries.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); product facts come from bin/tda rows dbo.ZnodePimProduct (2026-11-05) and the approved Playwright quick-order entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
